problem.title: Brain-Split Recovery Overwrites in Active-Active Multi-Master Relational Topologies
problem.prompt: MySQL Galera cluster partitioned across two datacenters reconnecting after a 1-hour network fiber repair .
requirements: Operational Invariant: "Active-active relational topologies must disallow writes immediately upon loss of majority quorum to guarantee deterministic recovery."
Production Hardening: Galera must be configured with wsrep_auto_evict and quorum strictness; a minority partition must automatically drop into non-primary state and refuse writes during isolation.
Prevent cascading failure by isolating downstream degradation at the ingress boundary.

stages.learnerPrompt: What catastrophic failure physics occur when capacity limits or downstream dependencies degrade under peak load?

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: Scale Surge → Unbounded Contention → Physical Bottleneck → 💥 Outage Cascade.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: Both partitions accepted divergent writes during the partition. When the network reconnects, automatic replication merges overwrite conflicting rows indiscriminately, corrupting inventory balances and user account tables.
Breakdown Chain: Scale Surge → Unbounded Contention → Physical Bottleneck → 💥 Outage Cascade
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
